topic: Claiming a Phone Warranty at the Counter

script.title: AT THE WARRANTY COUNTER
script.scene_zh: 手機維修櫃台 · 申請保固
script.story_hook: A mystery line appears on the phone screen.
script.intro_zh: 手機螢幕上，莫名出現一條線。
script.welcome_en: Hello hello, you made it! Today we claim a phone warranty at the counter.
script.welcome_zh: 哈囉哈囉，你來啦！今天要申請手機保固。
script.outro: Two hours later, good as new. That's today's story!
script.outro_zh: 兩小時後，手機煥然一新。今天的故事就到這裡！
script.practice_intro_en: Let's practice together, line by line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們一起來練習，一句一句唸。

script.char_b_description: a cheerful young man with wavy chestnut hair under a tilted grey cap, wearing a black tech polo with a brand patch, spinning a screwdriver while listening
script.youtube_title: 【📱手機保固英文】🛠️「像是出廠瑕疵」💸免費維修、備用機一次搞懂｜Phone Warranty English
script.youtube_title_en: “Looks Like a Factory Defect” — Claiming a Phone Warranty
script.youtube_description:
手機沒摔卻出現一條線，能走保固嗎？這段維修櫃台對話幫你分清人為損壞與出廠瑕疵！在手機維修中心，跟著 Lily 一起描述問題、確認免費維修、安排備用手機。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就會開口用。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
A line on your screen, but you never dropped your phone? This warranty counter dialogue explains the difference between damage and a factory defect. Follow Lily as she describes the problem, confirms a free repair, and requests a loaner phone — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA, plus line-by-line repeat practice in the second half.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】📱手機保固英文｜描述螢幕問題・分辨瑕疵與損壞・安排備用機｜聽完就會用｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
手機明明待在口袋裡，螢幕卻出現一條線？
出廠瑕疵跟人為損壞，英文要怎麼分？

這一集帶大家走進手機維修櫃台，Lily 的手機在大更新後出現細線，工程師從檢查、判定瑕疵、算好維修時間，到安排備用手機，全程都是自然的美式口語。

你會聽到：
🛠️ 描述問題：例如「this phone has a line on the screen」、「it started right after the big update」。
💸 保固判定：例如「that looks like a factory defect」、「damage costs cash, defects are free」。
🔌 維修安排：例如「how long will the fix take」、「can I get a loaner?」

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次手機鬧脾氣，帶著保固這些話，從容走到櫃台！
script.thumbnail_action: pointing at a line on the phone screen

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, this phone has a line on the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ðɪs foʊn hæz ə laɪn ɑn ðə skriːn/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，這支手機螢幕上有一條線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ooh, that's no fun. Did it drop?
dialogue.phonetic: /uː ðæts nɑː fʌn dɪd ɪt drɑːp/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never! It lived in my pocket, I promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər ɪt lɪvd ɪn maɪ ˈpɑːkɪt aɪ ˈprɑːmɪs/
dialogue.zh: 從沒有！它都待在我口袋裡，我發誓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, let me look closer, one second.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ lɛt mi lʊk ˈkloʊsər wʌn ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 好的，我湊近看看，稍等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It started right after the big update.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈstɑːrtɪd raɪt ˈæftər ðə bɪɡ əpˈdeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 它是大更新之後才開始的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, that looks like a factory defect, friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ðæt lʊks laɪk ə ˈfæktəri ˈdiːfɛkt frɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這看起來像是出廠瑕疵，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that a good thing for my wallet?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ə ɡʊd θɪŋ fɔːr maɪ ˈwɑːlɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那對錢包來說是好消息嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! Damage costs cash; defects are free here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈdæmɪdʒ kɑːsts kæʃ ˈdiːfɛkts ɑːr friː hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 是的！人為損壞要收費，瑕疵免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Amazing. How long will the fix take?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈmeɪzɪŋ haʊ lɔːŋ wɪl ðə fɪks teɪk/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About two hours, we do it in store.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt tuː ˈaʊərz wi duː ɪt ɪn stɔːr/
dialogue.zh: 大約兩小時，我們直接在店裡修。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh wow. My photos, are they safe there?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ waʊ maɪ ˈfoʊtoʊz ɑːr ðeɪ seɪf ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 哇。那我的照片會安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Backup first, always. Do you use cloud?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbækʌp fɜːrst ˈɔːlweɪz duː ju juːz klaʊd/
dialogue.zh: 一定要先備份。你有用雲端相簿嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 有，每天夜裡都會自動同步。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. I'll print your ticket, take a seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜːrfɪkt aɪl prɪnt jɔːr ˈtɪkɪt teɪk ə siːt/
dialogue.zh: 完美，我列印一張單給你，先坐一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing — can I get a loaner?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔːr θɪŋ kæn aɪ ɡɛt ə ˈloʊnər/
dialogue.zh: 對了，能借我一支備用手機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, just ID for it, back in a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr dʒʌst ˌaɪˈdiː fɔːr ɪt bæk ɪn ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 可以，押身分證就好，馬上回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great service honestly. Here's my card, all yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt ˈsɜːrvɪs ˈɑːnəstli hɪrz maɪ kɑːrd ɔːl jɔːrz/
dialogue.zh: 服務真不賴。卡給你，全部交給你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks! I'll call your name when it's ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks aɪl kɔːl jɔːr neɪm wɛn ɪts ˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！修好我會叫你的名字。
